title: Visibility
description: When the overlay is shown: during gameplay only, also on the results screen, or always

title: Show EARLY / LATE
description: Pop up EARLY (left side, under its label) or LATE (right side) for hits outside the threshold

title: EARLY color
description: Text color of the EARLY popup

title: LATE color
description: Text color of the LATE popup

title: EARLY / LATE threshold (ms)
description: 'auto' uses the best judgement window (mania 320, otherwise 300); a number sets a fixed threshold in real milliseconds (rate mods already accounted for), 0 shows it on every hit

title: Hit line lifetime (s)
description: Seconds a hit stays on the bar before fading out
